summary.name: Silly Robot Cards
summary.one_liner: A web service for creating personalised birthday and other greeting cards using photos, pets, hobbies and inside jokes, which can be printed and posted or sent as an eCard.
use_cases: Making a personalised birthday card with a photo of a friend or family member
Creating a birthday card featuring a pet
Writing a card around a hobby or inside joke
Ordering a printed card posted to the recipient
Designing a personalised Christmas card with pets or family jokes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a three-step flow: add a photo, favourite things and personal details; choose a design, tweak the artwork and write a message; then share the artwork or order a printed card. Cards can include photos, pets, ages, hobbies and custom jokes, and you can preview and edit before ordering. Orders are printed in the UK with an envelope, typically within about 3 business days, and can also be sent as a birthday eCard. The site also offers ready-made templates (for example for dads, mums and best mates) and a birthday face swap feature.
notable: Printed in the UK and posted with an envelope, typically around 3 business days
Preview and edit the card before ordering
Custom cards from your own photo, pets and inside jokes
Birthday eCard option and birthday face swap
caveats: Cards start from £3.99, so printed orders cost money
Printing and posting is limited to the UK delivery timeframe stated on the page
